name: Local Manga (Custom)
description: A custom metadata source for manga not on AniList/MangaUpdates. Serves a user-curated catalog (from a URL or inline JSON) so obscure titles appear in your collection and can be read with any installed manga provider.
author: Carloss616

fields.name: catalogUrl
fields.label: Catalog URL — public raw JSON (gist/repo raw, or http://localhost:8000/catalog.json). No token; leave empty to use the inline JSON below.

fields.name: catalog
fields.label: Inline catalog JSON (used when Catalog URL is empty). The default below is an editable example — replace it with your own entries (full field list in the README).
